programme.desc: King Tut's Tomb - the Hidden Chamber: Since Howard Carter's discovery in 1922, archaeologists have been trying to unlock the secrets of Tutankhamen's tomb. (Part 4 of 6) (S)

programme.title: Treasures Decoded
programme.desc: Search for the Holy Grail: The quest for the Holy Grail has consumed knights, Crusaders and Hollywood alike. One church in Spain says they have found the secret chalice. (Part 5 of 6) (S)

programme.title: Treasures Decoded
programme.desc: A team of experts have found evidence of a catastrophe that wiped out a technically advanced Mediterranean civilisation 3,500 years ago. (Part 6 of 6) (S)

programme.title: Paris: Stories from the City
programme.desc: City of Kings: Charts the city's growth from ancient times until the end of the Ancient Regime, when Kings Louis the 9th and Louis the 14th embraced and encouraged a high culture. (Part 1 of 3) (S)

programme.title: Paris: Stories from the City
programme.desc: City of Revolutions: Despite ongoing violence, protests, invasion and a civil war, Napoleon and his nephew were great builders who set about reinventing the city. (Part 2 of 3) (S)

programme.title: Paris: Stories from the City
programme.desc: The Secular City: The revolt against religion found its voice in heroes such as Victor Hugo, who were celebrated in great secular monuments such as the Pantheon. (Part 3 of 3) (S)

programme.title: Weathered: Earth's Extremes
programme.desc: Are We at the Tipping Point?: Discover how critical our climate systems are for our planet's stability, and learn the science behind these changes and how to protect our planet's future. (Part 1 of 6)

programme.desc: An 8-Bit Princess. When Meemaw gives Sheldon his first video game, it takes over their lives. Meanwhile, George Sr. gets jealous when Georgie bonds with Herschel. S2, Ep8

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Family Dynamics And Red Fiero. Sheldon studies his family for a psychology project when their Thanksgiving dinner turns into a fight after George Sr. is offered a job in Oklahoma. S2, Ep9

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Stunted Childhood. When Sheldon learns that stunted childhoods can turn people into outcasts, he tries to act his age. Meemaw and Dr. Sturgis's relationship is tested. S2, Ep10

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Race Of Superhumans. While Missy unknowingly becomes Sheldon's test subject, Georgie joins Mary's Bible study to spend more time with his crush, Veronica. S2, Ep11

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Tummy Ache And Whale Metaphor. When Sheldon has to spend a few days in the hospital, he turns into the world's worst patient, and his behaviour takes a toll on everyone. S2, Ep12

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Nuclear Reactor And Boy Lovey. While Sheldon attempts to build a nuclear reactor to power the neighbourhood, Georgie is heartbroken when he learns that Veronica has a boyfriend. S2, Ep13

programme.title: Georgie & Mandy's First Marriage
programme.desc: Two Idiots On A Dirt Bike. Georgie's attempt to break up Missy and her new boyfriend backfires, with severe consequences. S1, Ep17

programme.title: Georgie & Mandy's First Marriage
programme.desc: TV Money. Mandy tries to prove she's financially responsible after being called out on her poor spending habits, and Connor's girlfriend needs a place to stay. S1, Ep18

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Roommate Transmogrification. Mrs. Wolowitz ends up in the hospital after Howard tells her he's marrying Bernadette. While there, Leonard stresses over Penny and Priya. S4, Ep24

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Skank Reflex Analysis. Penny worries that she's screwed things up permanently with her friends after her night with Raj, while Sheldon takes command of the paintball team. S5, Ep1

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Pulled Groin Extrapolation. Leonard and Amy get to know each other better at a co-worker's wedding. Howard and Bernadette spend the weekend with Mrs. Wolowitz! S5, Ep3

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Wiggly Finger Catalyst. Raj is upset he's the only one of the four guys who's not in a relationship, so Penny sets out to find the perfect date. S5, Ep4

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Russian Rocket Reaction, The. Sheldon and Leonard get invited to a housewarming party at Wil Wheaton's house. Howard gets an out-of-this-world opportunity! S5, Ep5

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Rhinitis Revelation. Craving a little motherly love, Sheldon competes with the gang for his mother's attention when she comes to visit. S5, Ep6

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Good Guy Fluctuation. A cute comic book artist tests Leonard's relationship with Priya, while Sheldon, getting into the Halloween spirit, tries to scare the guys. S5, Ep7

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Isolation Permutation. Amy is heartbroken when Bernadette and Penny go shopping for wedding dresses without her. S5, Ep8

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Ornithophobia Diffusion. Can friends with benefits still be friends without? Leonard and Penny try hanging out alone, while Sheldon must overcome his fear of birds. S5, Ep9

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Flaming Spittoon Acquisition. Sheldon becomes jealous and considers taking his relationship with Amy to the next level when Stuart from the comic book store asks her out on a date. S5, Ep10

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Speckerman Recurrence. Leonard must face his fears after being contacted by his high school tormentor, while Penny realises that she might have been a bully herself. S5, Ep11

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Shiny Trinket Maneuver. Sheldon gets in trouble with Amy, and it's up to Penny to teach him how to be a better boyfriend. Howard deals with Bernadette's dislike of children. S5, Ep12

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Recombination Hypothesis. Everything might change when Leonard offers Penny a spur of the moment invitation to a romantic dinner for two on the 100th episode of the series. S5, Ep13

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Beta Test Initiation. Leonard and Penny experiment with dating again by 'beta testing' their relationship. Raj develops a weird bond with his phone's virtual assistant. S5, Ep14

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Friendship Contraction. Sheldon's selfish demands force Leonard to reconsider their friendship. Meanwhile, Howard tries to pick his astronaut nickname. S5, Ep15

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Vacation Solution. When Sheldon is forced to take a vacation by the university, he goes to work with Amy in her neurobiology lab. S5, Ep16

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Rothman Disintegration. When a corner office at the university opens, Sheldon must compete for it with his office nemesis, Barry Kripke. Penny gets an unusual gift from Amy. S5, Ep17

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Werewolf Transformation. A change in Sheldon's routine forces him to re-evaluate his entire life, when his barber is sick. Howard rethinks his decision to go into space. S5, Ep18

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Weekend Vortex. Sheldon chooses to participate in a guys-only weekend Star Wars gaming marathon rather than go with Amy to her aunt's birthday party. S5, Ep19

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Transporter Malfunction. It's a dream come true for Sheldon when he has a close encounter with his hero, Mr. Spock -legendary sci-fi icon Leonard Nimoy. S5, Ep20

programme.title: Who Do You Do?

programme.title: Adventures of a Plumber's Mate
programme.desc: 1978. Comedy. Director: Stanley Long. Stars Chris Neil, Christopher Biggins, Lindy Benson. Plumber's mate Sid meets ladies at work. Susie is unaware of his dalliances as he gets into debt trouble.

programme.title: Look At Life Early Starters

programme.title: The Rogues

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood

programme.title: The Buccaneers

programme.title: Look At Life Having a Baby

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: The Sign of Four

programme.desc: A Corpse in Room 13. 1955. Stars Margaret Anderson & Phil Brown. A wealthy gentleman checks into a hotel and ends up dead. In financial desperation, the hotelier makes a series of bad decisions.
